blocks.value: Most companies borrow money at some stage of their growth. This borrowed money is called debt.
Imagine This: A company wants to build a new factory costing ₹500 crore. Instead of waiting many years to save the money, it borrows from a bank and repays the loan gradually from future profits.
Debt itself is not bad. Borrowing to expand a successful business can be a smart decision. Problems arise when a company borrows more than it can comfortably repay.
Many infrastructure companies have significant debt because building roads, airports or power plants requires large investments.
⚠️ Very high debt combined with falling profits can put a company under financial pressure.
Always look at debt together with a company's ability to earn profits and generate cash.

blocks.question: Is debt always a bad thing?
choices: No. Responsible borrowing can help a company grow.
Yes. Every company should avoid debt completely.
Debt has no effect on businesses.

blocks.question: When can debt become a problem?
choices: When a company struggles to repay it.
When a company earns strong profits.
When a company has valuable assets.
